name: SkillTrainer shipped content
note: Packs load in order and merge. To install content, drop a JSON file in content/packs/ and add it to this list. No code change is needed. Every category must have exactly 4 tiers (I Basic Awareness, II Foundational, III Skilled, IV Advanced); a pack that does not is reported and skipped. An exported pack may carry an `assets` map of base64 files, which are restored on import.
